title: Unable to sync AAPS 3.1 with Sony Smartwatch 3
body:
Good night. My Sony Smartwatch 3 doesn't get data from AAPS once updated (the phone and the watch) to version 3.1. I have tried every single thing I can think of to make it work with no luck. If I downgrade to 3.0.2 (once again the phone and the watch) everything works fine. The app works in the watch and of course on the phone, but they don't sync. In AAPS it says "No watch connected" but I get notifications and data from xDrip+ and, as I said, if I downgrade it works again. I have read the logs but it's too much to me, I'm afraid I don't understand anything :-(
Any help is welcome.
Thank you in advance.

![SWR3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23319786/180096556-f70c1251-2a17-4992-b528-949635a774cd.jpg)
![SWR1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23319786/180096519-e4f2c9a0-8afc-4467-8440-74dad005dba5.jpg)
